embeds.title: HOW THE BLHA WORKS
embeds.description: The league uses two homes with different jobs. Keeping those jobs separate makes disputes, records, and league administration much cleaner.

fields.name: FANTRAX — AUTHORITATIVE GAME RECORD
fields.value:
Rosters • lineups • scoring • adds/drops • FAAB • trades • standings • playoff results

If a gameplay transaction or result exists in Fantrax, Fantrax is the authoritative record.

fields.name: DISCORD — THE CLUBHOUSE + FRONT OFFICE
fields.value: Announcements • voting • trade market • scouting • league discussion • records • draft-day communication • commissioner support

fields.name: ONE FRANCHISE, ONE VOICE
fields.value: Co-owners may fully help manage a franchise, but each franchise has **one formal league vote** and **one dues obligation**.
